gloss: member (of a group, troupe, or organization)

definitions.gloss: member of a group / troupe / corps / squad
definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to an organized group whose name ends in -{団|だん} — for example a theater troupe, orchestra, children's sports team, fire brigade, scout group, or boys' and girls' club. The word identifies the person as one of the members, without specifying rank.

examples.japanese: {団員|だんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: To become a member (of the group).

examples.japanese: ⟦{合唱|がっしょう}{団|だん}→合唱団：17723_gasshoudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The choir is recruiting new members.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{団|だん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: As a member of the volunteer fire brigade, I help protect the community.

examples.japanese: ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん}たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The troupe's members keep up strict daily practice in preparation for their performance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, corps, troupe) and the suffix -{員|いん} (member, staff member). Pairs naturally with any organization whose name ends in -⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧: ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん} (troupe member), ⟦{楽団|がくだん}→楽団：13181_gakudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん} (orchestra member), ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{団|だん}→消防団：29795_shouboudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団員|だんいん} (volunteer fire brigade member), and so on.

USAGE:
Neutral in tone and widely used in news reports, recruitment notices, and organizational self-description. Because {団員|だんいん} only covers groups named -⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧, it cannot be used for members of political parties (⟦{党員|とういん}→党員：25979_touin⟧), societies (⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧), or ordinary companies (⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧). The number of members is often expressed with the counter -{名|めい}, e.g. {団員|だんいん}20{名|めい} (20 members).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団員|だんいん}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧: recruiting members
- {団員|だんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a member
- {団員|だんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める: to quit being a member
- {新|しん}{団員|だんいん}: new member
- {団員|だんいん}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of members
- {団員|だんいん}⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧: list / roster of members

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: member — used for groups whose name ends in -⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (society, club, association)
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: employee; company member — a member of a ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ (company)
- ⟦{党員|とういん}→党員：25979_touin⟧: party member — a member of a political party (⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧)
- {組合員|くみあいいん}: union / cooperative member — a member of a ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧
- ⟦{部員|ぶいん}→部員：27409_buin⟧: club / section member — a member of a ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (e.g., a school club)
- {隊員|たいいん}: squad / unit member — a member of a ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧, such as a police or rescue unit
